summary.text: Joe Moody is a Democratic state representative from Texas House District 78 who has served since 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Ballotpedia lists no opponent.

paragraphs.text: Joseph Moody, who is also known as Joe, earned a bachelor's degree from New Mexico State University and a law degree from Texas Tech University, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as attorney.
He assumed office in the Texas House in 2013.
For 2023-2024 he was assigned to the Criminal Jurisprudence Committee as chair, and to the House Administration, Judiciary & Civil Jurisprudence and Redistricting committees.
In 2019-2022 he served as vice chair of the Calendars Committee.
He advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary with no primary opponent listed.
